title: Sheet-Pan Sausage & Green Beans
description: Smoky sausage and green beans with crisp-edged potatoes.
substitutions: Use broccoli instead of green beans.

steps.text: Toss potatoes with 1 tablespoon oil, garlic powder, and pepper. Roast for 15 minutes.
Add sliced sausage and green beans with the remaining 1 tablespoon oil. Toss and roast 15 more minutes until potatoes are tender.

storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly and use within 3–4 days.

title: Lemon Garlic Broccoli Pasta
description: Bright pasta with tender broccoli, garlic, lemon, and Parmesan.
substitutions: Use a splash of bottled lemon juice if needed.

steps.text: Boil pasta. During the final 3 minutes, add 3 cups broccoli to the same pot; reserve 1/2 cup cooking water and drain.
Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil with garlic in the empty pot for 30 seconds.
Return pasta and broccoli. Add juice from 1 lemon, Parmesan, and enough pasta water to make it glossy. Toss and serve.

title: One-Pot Sausage Orzo
description: Creamy orzo with browned sausage and spinach in one pan.
substitutions: Frozen chopped spinach can replace fresh.

steps.text: Brown 12 ounces sausage in a large skillet, breaking it into crumbles.
Stir in 1 cup orzo and Italian seasoning for 1 minute.
Add 2 1/2 cups broth. Simmer uncovered 12–14 minutes, stirring often, until orzo is tender.
Stir in spinach until wilted, then Parmesan.

title: Cabbage & Egg Noodle Skillet
description: Soft buttery cabbage and onions tossed with egg noodles.
substitutions: Add sliced smoked sausage if desired.
Use wide pasta if egg noodles are unavailable.

steps.text: Boil 8 ounces egg noodles until tender; drain.
Melt 3 tablespoons butter in a large skillet. Add onion and cabbage with salt and pepper.
Cook cabbage 12–15 minutes, stirring often, until soft and lightly golden.
Toss in the drained noodles and heat through.
